title: 第25章 疯狂突破炼体术第26章 妖艳女子林中怪异
slug: 九叔系统道术给我全加满
content_zh:
林凡不敢懈怠，气息流转，引动周身气脉。
调息吐纳，任由灵气全身流转。
那种微痛，麻痹的感觉再一次袭来。
可林凡却嘴角微微上扬，微笑了起来。
这种感觉比之前的冲刷，还要爽！
更加的让人，心神为之振奋。
轰！
【系统提示：恭喜宿主已突破至先天二重天】
【系统提示：恭喜宿主已突破至先天三重天】
【系统提示：恭喜宿主已突破至先天四重天】
数道声音从脑海中传来。
缓缓睁眼，林凡不敢置信的欣喜。
运行周身气脉，气息迸发而出。
只见此刻。
气息的边缘，已由刺状变为弧状。
气息蕴含着磅礴的爆发力。
内含的气息，与之前相比竟精纯了数倍，气势雄浑！
“系统，打开属性面板！”
姓名：林凡
境界：先天四重天

法器：桃木剑（道术增幅100%）
道经：神鬼七杀令（一阶）
道法：紫霄神雷（大圆满）、锁魂驱邪符（大圆满）、通天眼（入门）、杀破令（入门）
功德：0
……
“什么叫天才啊？”
林凡面带喜色，感叹起来。
若是此时再与那老仆人相比。
怕是一个照面能将其轰倒。
来多三五具紫僵也不在话下。
只是功德用完了，还得多搞点才是！
杀破令和通天眼也方才入门，能提升的空间还很大啊！
未来可期，未来可期！
林凡长吐了口气浊气，不作多想，倒头睡去。
……
content_en:
Lin Fan did not dare to slack off, and his breath circulated, activating the energy channels throughout his body.
Breathing and breathing, let the spiritual energy flow throughout the body.
That slight pain and numb feeling came over me again.
But Lin Fan raised the corners of his mouth slightly and smiled.
This feeling is even better than the previous flush!
It makes people even more excited.
boom!
[System prompt: Congratulations to the host for breaking through to the second level of innate heaven]
[System prompt: Congratulations to the host for breaking through to the third level of innate heaven]
[System prompt: Congratulations to the host for breaking through to the fourth level of innate heaven]
Several voices came from his mind.
Lin Fan slowly opened his eyes, feeling unbelievably happy.
Run the Qi meridians throughout the body, and the breath will burst out.
I only see this moment.
The edge of the breath has changed from thorn-shaped to arc-shaped.
The breath contains majestic explosive power.
The aura contained in it was several times purer and more powerful than before!
"System, open the properties panel!"
Name: Lin Fan
Realm: Innate Fourth Level
Magical weapon: Peach wood sword (Taoist skills increased by 100%)
Taoist Scriptures: Seven Killing Orders of Gods and Ghosts (First Level)
Taoism: Purple Sky Divine Thunder (Dzogchen), Soul-Locking Exorcism Talisman (Dzogchen), Eye of Heaven (Introduction), Killing Order (Introduction)
Merit: 0
…
"What is a genius?"
Lin Fan sighed with joy on his face.
If compared with the old servant at this time.
I'm afraid that one face-to-face blow could knock him down.
It's no problem to have three or five purple zombies.
It’s just that the merit has been used up, so we need to do more!
Sha Po Ling and Heavenly Eye have just started, and there is still a lot of room for improvement!
The future is promising, the future is promising!
Lin Fan let out a long breath and fell asleep without thinking too much.
